metadata.title: Three New Late-type Hypervelocity Star Candidates from Gaia DR2 with Refined Selection Criteria

evidence.quote: Our final candidate sample consists of only Gaia-HVSC1, Gaia-HVSC2, and Gaia-HVSC3

notes: Final candidates_found are Gaia-HVSC1 (Gaia DR2 5716044263405220096), Gaia-HVSC2 (Gaia DR2 5850309098637075328), and Gaia-HVSC3 (Gaia DR2 5966712023814100736); T:p11-b5 explicitly says the final candidate sample consists only of these three, and Table 2 (I:p19-b0) gives P_un = 1.000 for all three. The other 13 initially selected HVS candidates are not counted as candidates_found because T:p11-b5 eliminates them after the neighbor-contamination check; the looser statement at T:p13-b2 about including the 15 low-rv_nb_transits objects is not the final assessment. Gaia-HVSC15 (Gaia DR2 5932173855446728064) is follow_up only: T:p13-b2 identifies it as one of Marchetti et al.'s 19 HVS candidates, whereas T:p11-b5 leaves it out of the final three. HV2 (Gaia DR2 1268023196461923712), HV3 (Gaia DR2 1364548016594914560), HV4 (Gaia DR2 2106519830479009920), HV6 (Gaia DR2 3705761936916676864), HV7 (Gaia DR2 3784964943489710592), HV11 (Gaia DR2 4916199478888664320), HV12 (Gaia DR2 5212817273334550016), HV14 (Gaia DR2 5374177064347894272), HV18 (Gaia DR2 6397497209236655872), and HV19 (Gaia DR2 6431596947468407552) are follow_up only: T:p13-b2 reclassifies 10 of Marchetti et al.'s 19 HVS candidates as high-velocity candidates, and the M superscripts plus the note at T:p20-b0 identify these ten. Table 3's first-column header is transcribed as 'Gaia-HVSC', but the prose uses HV labels (e.g. HV22 at T:p10-b3) and Table 4 uses HV; I therefore use HV labels for these high-velocity stars to avoid confusion with the final Gaia-HVSC1-3. Known HVSs mentioned only in the introduction or as comparison objects (e.g. Li10 at T:p2-b2 and T:p17-b0) are not counted because the paper does not analyze them as sample candidates.

Gaia-HVSC1: Target identified as Gaia-HVSC1 (Table 1, source id 5716044263405220096). Coordinates are the Gaia DR2 equatorial position at epoch J2015.5 as listed in Table 1. The paper does not report a separate heliocentric distance for this star (it only gives r_GC in Table 2 and inverts parallaxes generally), so no distance value is recorded. No bound probability is reported; P_un = 1.000 corresponds to unbound probability. Table 2 gives v_esc = 605^{+1}_{-1} km/s, v_resc1 = 802.59 km/s and v_resc2 = -377.88 km/s; these are escape/radial-escape speeds, not the star's velocity, so they are not recorded. RUWE = 0.947.

Gaia-HVSC2: Gaia-HVSC2 is Gaia DR2 5850309098637075328 (Table 1 row 2; Table 2 row 2). No heliocentric distance is explicitly tabulated for this star; the paper only states d = 1/ϖ (T:p4-b3) and reports parallax, so no distance was computed. The several unbound probabilities in Table 2 are retained as separate conditional results; bound probabilities are not reported.

Gaia-HVSC3: Target is Gaia-HVSC3 (Table 1 row 3, source id 5966712023814100736). Table 1 lists NB_rv = 2 (number of transits for radial velocity). Distance is not given directly except through parallax (d = 1/ϖ). Table 2 values for P_un = 1.000 refer to unbound probability (bound probability not reported). The BEPA P'_un = 0.989 is the binary escape probability. Section 5.2 notes the star is K-type with Teff = 4166 K and that its past trajectory does not pass close enough to the Galactic center for a GC origin.

Gaia-HVSC15: Target is Gaia-HVSC15 = Gaia DR2 5932173855446728064. The paper reports its Gaia radial velocity as -614.3 ± 2.5 km/s but identifies this value as erroneous because of contamination from a close neighbor (T:p10-b2, T:p18-b2); Boubert et al. (2019) give a ground-based eight-epoch median of -56.5 ± 5.3 km/s (T:p10-b2). Therefore the Table 2 Galactic-rest-frame velocity and P_un values for row 15 are conditional on the uncorrected Gaia radial velocity, as the table notes state values are shown “as is” (T:p18-b2, T:p19-b0). Gaia-HVSC15 is not among the paper’s final clean HVS sample of Gaia-HVSC1–3 (T:p11-b5). No separate heliocentric distance is explicitly reported for this star; Table 2 gives r_GC from 1/varpi.

HV2: Target is HV2 = Gaia DR2 1268023196461923712, row 2 of Table 3 (basic parameters) and row 2 of Table 4 (unbound probabilities); it is flagged "M" (listed in Marchetti et al. 2018b). No heliocentric distance is reported in the paper; only parallax (0.22 ± 0.02 mas) and the galactocentric radius r_GC are given, so distance was not extracted. The unbound probabilities are given for three conditions (nominal, 30 km/s escape-velocity perturbation, and parallax offset), all extracted as distinct reported results. The star is marked GOOD for radial velocity (no brighter companions within 6.4 arcsec; RUWE = 1.061).

HV3: The target is HV3 in Table 3 (Gaia DR2 1364548016594914560, marked M), a high-velocity-star candidate, not Gaia-HVSC3 in Table 1. No heliocentric distance is explicitly reported for HV3; only its parallax is tabulated, so no distance is extracted. The paper reports unbound probabilities but no bound probability, so no bound probability is included. Table 4 reports three distinct unbound-probability calculations for this star: P_un = 0.304, P_30,un = 0.320, and P_(varpi+0.067),un = 0.000; all are retained with their applicable conditions.

HV4: HV4 is row 4 in Tables 3 and 4 (T:p20-b0, T:p21-b0). No individual heliocentric distance is tabulated for HV4; I omitted distance rather than calculating it from the parallax. The three unbound probabilities are retained separately because they correspond to different stated treatments of the escape velocity or parallax offset.

HV6: HV6 is the row labeled 6^B,M in Table 3 and row 6 in Table 4, with Gaia DR2 source id 3705761936916676864 (locations T:p20-b0 and T:p21-b0; images I:p20-b0 and I:p21-b0). The B,M superscripts indicate the source is also listed in Bromley et al. (2018) and Marchetti et al. (2018b).

HV7: Target HV7 (Gaia DR2 3784964943489710592) is a high velocity star candidate (Table 3, row 7; marked "M" = also listed in Marchetti et al. 2018b), with unbound probabilities in Table 4, row 7. Column headings of Table 3 are labelled "Gaia-HVSC" but the values are the HV sample (HV7).
